verdict.rationale: Sentry ships its own AI agent (Seer), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents the opposite role: an official Sentry MCP server that lets outside AI assistants query Sentry, plus 'MCP access' on the pricing page. Nothing shows Seer or any other Sentry feature connecting to third-party MCP servers to use their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
